http:
  routers:
    backend-dev:
      rule: "Host(`localhost`) && (PathPrefix(`/api`) || PathPrefix(`/swagger-ui`) || PathPrefix(`/api-docs`))"
      entryPoints: [web]
      service: backend-dev
    frontend-dev:
      rule: "Host(`localhost`)"
      entryPoints: [web]
      service: frontend-dev
  services:
    backend-dev:
      loadBalancer:
        servers:
          - url: "http://host.docker.internal:3030"
    frontend-dev:
      loadBalancer:
        servers:
          - url: "http://host.docker.internal:5173"
